goal: Design and execute a clean-room core rewrite of Native Gravity into NTG 2.0 (Season 2): an autonomous LLM orchestration system centered on interactive Steamroller + LedgerKernel, resolving governing spec conflicts in m0 before runtime implementation, with Hydrogen XHigh/High/Medium execution and review tiers, Flash Low lightweight workers, model-aware harnesses, universal mutation safety guards, 1.x data/config round-trip compatibility, and a simple /ntg user entry flow.
constraints: PO_CONFIRMED: Steamroller routes Carbon (Medium) -> Gemini 4 Argon (Medium) by default; AGY Orchestrator (gemini-pro-orchestrator-g1-pro) is excluded from default routing.

PO_CONFIRMED: Role lineup — Piledriver (Argon High), Bulldozer (Hydrogen XHigh), Bobcat (Hydrogen Medium), Strix Halo (Hydrogen High), Jaguar (Gemini 3.8 Flash Low), Puma (Gemini 3.8 Flash Low, NOT merged into Bobcat), Excavator (COMPLETELY RETIRED, replaced by Bulldozer + Instinct), Zen (Opus 5.5 High with fallback permitted).

CONFIRMED: Model routing is decoupled from role authority — Steamroller may dynamically override a role's model (capability/intelligence selection) without expanding that role's tool permissions, mutation authority, delegation authority, or verification requirements.
PO_CONFIRMED: Strix Halo (Hydrogen High) is invocable by Steamroller, Bulldozer, and Bobcat.

PO_CONFIRMED: Track verification & completion guarantees — Track L (Halo REQUIRED, Zen OMITTED by default, lightweight log), Track S (Halo CONDITIONAL, Zen REQUIRED, ledger), Track M (Halo REQUIRED, Zen REQUIRED, ledger). High-risk escalation is judged by Steamroller; Halo and Zen verdicts remain strictly distinguished.

CONFIRMED: Halo reviews bind to candidate/run ID, reviewed diff/tree digest, acceptance criteria digest, and plan_version; any change to the deliverable, criteria, or evidence basis invalidates prior Halo ACCEPT as STALE.
PO_CONFIRMED: Tactical Replan marks all existing Zen GO verdicts STALE and requires full revalidation.

PO_CONFIRMED: Tool repetition uses a strict observation-first telemetry policy — legacy hard-count budget-guard blocking is removed and never runs alongside the new telemetry policy; orchestration-level recovery safety caps are kept separate from per-turn tool/read count limits.

CONFIRMED: Universal safety boundaries protect authoritative/safety paths (.ntg/ledger.json, lock, lightweight log, hooks, plugin.json) and non-mutating roles across BOTH run_command AND file-mutation tools (write_to_file, replace_file_content, write_file, edit_file, etc.), with zero model-controlled bypass markers or shell exceptions; only LedgerKernel, LightweightLog, and the 1.x Compatibility Adapter mutate protected paths through internal host-process APIs.

PO_CONFIRMED: Model-Aware Harness uses Model-Common Calibration + Role-Specific Directives (optimizing prompts, context delivery, and tool interfaces) without homogenizing or suppressing native model traits, including a Lightweight Worker Harness from initial NTG 2.0 implementation. Reference GJC/OmO concepts without copying code or prompts.

CONFIRMED: Branch-local NTG 2.0 governing contracts (AGENTS.md, canonical architecture contract, rules/orchestration.md) must be aligned and verified in m0 BEFORE m1-m3 runtime code implementation, separate from m2 agent-file verification.

PO_CONFIRMED: Core runtime is rewritten from the ground up while preserving 1.x data and configuration compatibility (.ntg/ledger.json, plan.json, plugin.json, /ntg UX) verified via round-trip tests — no obligation to preserve 1.x MinimalSpine internal execution flow.

decision_invariants.decision: Separate m0 governing-spec verification from m2 agent-role verification: m0 establishes branch-local governing contracts (AGENTS.md, docs/specs/ntg-2.0-architecture-contract.md, docs/specs/vnext-architecture-contract.md, rules/orchestration.md) and verifies them with tests/test_governing_spec.mjs while decoupling rules/orchestration.md from tests/test_role_guidance.mjs so un-updated agents/*.md are not prematurely tested in m0; agents/*.md and role guidance/frontmatter tests update and run in m2.

Steamroller operates as an AGY interactive orchestrator coupled with LedgerKernel (hybrid control plane), autonomously deciding Track classification (L/S/M), dynamic model routing, delegation paths, Instinct invocation, and recovery retries within an orchestration-level hard safety cap. Model routing is capability selection only and never expands role authority (tool, mutation, delegation, or verification permissions).

Model lineup — PO_CONFIRMED: Steamroller (Carbon Medium -> gemini-4-argon-medium, excluding AGY Orchestrator), Piledriver (gemini-4-argon-high), Bulldozer (gemini-4-hydrogen-xhigh), Strix Halo (gemini-4-hydrogen-high), Bobcat (gemini-4-hydrogen-medium), Jaguar & Puma (gemini-3.8-flash-low, kept separate), Zen (claude-opus-5-5-high w/ fallback). EXISTING_BASELINE_DEFAULT: Zen fallback (gemini-4-argon-high), Instinct (claude-sonnet-5-5-high / opus-5-5-high), Navi (gemini-4-argon-medium).

Excavator is completely retired and legacy role/guard tests are audited and disposed in m2 (removing agents/excavator.md, scripts/excavator-agy.mjs, hooks/excavator-shell-guard.py, hooks/bulldozer-shell-guard.py, hooks/budget-guard.py, and obsolete test_excavator_agy.mjs, test_excavator_shell_guard.py, test_bulldozer_shell_guard.py, test_budget_guard.py, test_runner_bulldozer_marker.mjs, plus runner budget/marker plumbing and retired hooks.json registrations verified directly in m2). Hard recovery uses Bulldozer (Hydrogen XHigh) + Instinct. Preserved safety invariants operate universally across BOTH run_command AND file-mutation tools via hooks/shell-safety-guard.py and tests/test_shell_safety_guard.py with zero model-controlled bypass markers or shell exceptions.
decision_invariants.source_ref: PO Final Decisions §1, §3; Refinements #7, #3 & #4 (second pass); Final Contract Refinements #1, #2

decision_invariants.decision: Bulldozer (Hydrogen XHigh) is granted general run_command shell access enforced across all mutation paths (shell + file tools) by universal hooks/shell-safety-guard.py, while Strix Halo (Hydrogen High) is invocable by Steamroller, Bulldozer, and Bobcat via a unified caller-aware ReviewRequest contract.

Track completion guarantees strictly separate Halo (formative ACCEPT/REVISE/ESCALATE -> HALO_LIGHTWEIGHT on Track L) from Zen (independent summative GO/NO-GO -> ZEN_DURABLE on Track S/M and Steamroller-escalated high-risk tasks). Halo reviews bind to candidate/run ID, reviewed_diff_digest, acceptance_criteria_digest, and plan_version and become STALE on any change. Tactical Replan marks all prior Zen GO verdicts STALE for full revalidation.

NTG 2.0 implements a Model-Aware Harness (Model-Common Calibration + Role-Specific Directives) optimizing prompts, context delivery, and tool interfaces while preserving native model traits and avoiding behavioral homogenization or micro-management. Lightweight Worker Harness (Jaguar/Puma on 3.8 Flash Low) is included from initial implementation; unsuitable tasks reroute cleanly. Legacy hard-count budget-guard blocking (hooks/budget-guard.py, hooks.json role-budget-boundary, runner.mjs BULLDOZER_BUDGET_DEFAULTS) is removed and replaced with observation-first hooks/telemetry-guard.py, kept strictly separate from orchestration recovery retry safety caps.

Core runtime is rewritten cleanly from scratch (replacing MinimalSpine), maintaining backward compatibility for 1.x ledger.json, plan.json, plugin.json, and simple /ntg user entry UX, verified via full load->operate->save->reload round-trip tests; any protected data/config migration runs exclusively through the Compatibility Adapter's explicit internal code path (src/core/v1-compat.mjs), never via model-facing tools.
decision_invariants.source_ref: PO Final Decisions §5; Refinement #9; Final Contract Refinement #1

excluded_models: gemini-pro-orchestrator-g1-pro (AGY Orchestrator excluded from Steamroller default routing)
retired_roles: excavator (replaced by Bulldozer Hydrogen XHigh + Instinct)

model_priority_candidates.note: Primary when exposed on AGY catalog

dynamic_routing_contract.capability_vs_authority_boundary: Model selection controls capability/intelligence only. Dynamic model overrides NEVER expand a role's tool permissions, mutation authority, delegation authority, or verification requirements.
dynamic_routing_contract.reroute_principle: When a task exceeds a lightweight worker's capability (e.g., 3.8 Flash Low), Steamroller reroutes to a higher-tier role (e.g., Bobcat on Hydrogen Medium) or applies an authorized capability upgrade without altering authority boundaries.

responsibilities: Autonomously classify tasks into Track L, Track S, or Track M.
Decide whether to consult Piledriver, execute via direct workers (Jaguar/Puma/Bobcat), or delegate to Bulldozer (Hydrogen XHigh).
Judge high-risk escalation (e.g., requiring Zen on small high-risk changes).
Autonomously choose Instinct invocation timing and failure retry counts within LedgerKernel's orchestration-level hard safety cap.
Maintain user-facing communication in plain language without leaking internal ledger/role plumbing.

piledriver.permissions: READ_ONLY (no edits, no shell, no delegation, advisory only; enforced on both shell and file-mutation tools)
responsibilities: Initial milestone graph and interface architecture for Track M / complex tasks.
Tactical and material replan proposals and NEEDS_DEEP trade-off resolution.

bulldozer.role_title: Selective Execution Coordinator & Primary Recovery Lead
bulldozer.dispatch_mode: selective (complex milestones, multi-worker synthesis, and primary recovery alongside Instinct)
bulldozer.permissions: Read tools + subagent orchestration (Jaguar, Puma, Bobcat, Strix Halo) + GENERAL run_command shell access enforced across all mutation paths (shell + file tools) by universal hooks/shell-safety-guard.py (no direct ledger/hook mutation, no Zen invocation).
responsibilities: Decompose and coordinate complex milestones across Jaguar, Puma, and Bobcat.
Execute build/integration/test and diagnostic commands via general shell within universal safety boundaries.
Lead root-cause failure diagnosis and recovery (replacing retired Excavator) with optional Instinct escalation.

bobcat.permissions: File read/write within scope + run_command (both guarded against protected ledger/hook paths and unsafe effects by hooks/shell-safety-guard.py) + invoke_subagent limited to Strix Halo.
responsibilities: Perform substantive feature implementation, refactoring, stateful/API logic, bug fixes, and test authorship.
Invoke Strix Halo (Hydrogen High) when implementing under Track L/M or when local complex review is needed.

strix_halo.permissions: READ_ONLY (view_file, grep_search, list_dir, find_by_name; blocked from edits/shell/delegation across tool boundaries).

track_requirements.track_l: REQUIRED (acts as Track L completion gate when Zen is omitted)

jaguar.permissions: READ_ONLY (no edits, no shell, no delegation)
jaguar.reroute_policy: Tasks requiring deep cross-cutting reasoning unsuitable for Flash Low are rerouted by Steamroller/Bulldozer rather than inflating Jaguar's scope or authority.

puma.role_title: Lightweight Mechanical, Formatting & Config Worker (Retained Separately)
puma.permissions: Bounded text/config file edits (view/list/find/grep/write/replace guarded against protected ledger/hook paths; no shell, no delegation)
puma.rationale: Retained as a separate low-cost mechanical/formatting/config worker on 3.8 Flash Low; substantive code/state/test changes route to Bobcat (Hydrogen Medium).

quota_fallback.provenance: EXISTING_BASELINE_DEFAULT (PO permitted fallback; exact family/effort carried from 1.x baseline)

zen.permissions: Non-mutating verification enforced at execution boundary across BOTH run_command AND file-mutation tools via runner-injected NTG_ACTIVE_ROLE=zen in hooks/shell-safety-guard.py & hooks/zen-shell-guard.py; read tools + test execution; zero edits or delegation.

instinct.provenance: EXISTING_BASELINE_DEFAULT (PO confirmed autonomous Steamroller invocation timing)
instinct.permissions: READ_ONLY advisory specialist (no edits, no shell, no delegation).
instinct.dispatch_mode: Autonomous decision by Steamroller (also available as second leg of Bulldozer + Instinct recovery).

excavator.preserved_invariants: Privilege-escalation, destructive-effect, protected ledger/hook path integrity across shell and file tools, and marker anti-spoofing rules live in universal hooks/shell-safety-guard.py.

track_l.name: Lightweight Track
track_l.zen_policy: OMITTED_BY_DEFAULT (Steamroller escalates to Zen if task turns out high-risk)

approval_ux_policy.behavior: Lightweight direct execution with mandatory Halo review; Steamroller confirms before external/destructive actions or if escalated to Track S/M.

track_s.name: Standard Durable Track
track_s.halo_policy: CONDITIONAL (Steamroller/Bulldozer/Bobcat invoke on complex logic or pre-Zen polish)

approval_ux_policy.behavior: One initial plain-language plan approval on the normal execution path; exceptions requiring re-approval under PO policy (e.g., Material Replan changing goal/acceptance/invariants or external/irreversible confirmation gates) still trigger explicit user confirmation.
One initial plain-language plan approval on the normal execution path; Material Replan or destructive/external confirmation gates remain explicit re-approval exceptions.

track_verification_and_state_policy.verdict_distinction: LedgerKernel and LightweightLog store halo_reviews and zen_verdicts in separate typed fields. Halo ACCEPT closes Track L (HALO_LIGHTWEIGHT) only when fresh and bound; it never substitutes for Zen GO on Track S/M or high-risk work (ZEN_DURABLE).

stale_conditions: Delivered files or working-tree diff digest changes after Halo review.
Acceptance criteria or governing task contract changes.
Referenced evidence basis or test state changes.
halo_invalidation_policy.rule: Any stale Halo ACCEPT cannot be reused for a modified deliverable; a fresh Halo review against the current digest and contract is required.

replanning_policy.tactical_replan: Autonomously adopted by Steamroller (often with Piledriver advice) when execution strategy, scope boundaries, or remaining milestone structure changes without altering user-approved goal/acceptance. Marks ALL existing Zen GO verdicts (and Halo receipts bound to prior plan_version) STALE and requires full Zen revalidation (unchanged code need not be rewritten, only re-verified).
replanning_policy.material_replan: Changes user-approved goal, weakens/modifies acceptance_criteria, alters decision_invariants, or adds destructive side effects. Requires explicit user re-approval before adoption (exception to normal-path initial 1x approval) and marks all prior Zen GO verdicts STALE.

dedicated_harness_architecture.clean_room_provenance: Design principles inspired by GJC and OmO (layered calibration, targeted context delivery, model-ergonomic tool interfaces); zero code or prompt text copied.

layers.purpose: Preserve each model family's native reasoning, tool-use, and delegation tendencies without forcing uniform behavior. Intervene strictly on observed cross-model failures or host/tool interface friction (evidence labeling OBSERVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN, interface error clarity, no assumption filling), cleanly separated from role directives.
Provide concise role authority boundaries, allowed/disallowed tools, caller/callee contracts, and track verification semantics without micro-managing step-by-step model reasoning.
Auto-inject ContextDigest (scope_map, git diff stat, changed symbol ranges, failure summary) into delegation/review packets; keep tool interfaces crisp; provide unified Kernel CLI/API entry.

layers.layer: Lightweight Worker Harness (Jaguar & Puma, Gemini 3.8 Flash Low)
layers.purpose: Included from initial NTG 2.0 implementation: strictly bounded inputs, explicit fact/edit schemas, context-capped file-reading helpers, and reroute signals when a task exceeds Flash Low capability.

observation_first_telemetry.policy: True observation-first telemetry (hooks/telemetry-guard.py logging to .ntg/telemetry.jsonl). All legacy hard-count budget blocking (hooks/budget-guard.py, hooks.json role-budget-boundary, runner.mjs BULLDOZER_BUDGET_DEFAULTS) is removed so it never coexists with observation-first telemetry. Repetition count is strictly a telemetry signal, NEVER an automatic waste verdict or count-based block threshold (no fixed repetition-count threshold triggers auto-denial).
observation_first_telemetry.distinction_from_safety_cap: Per-turn tool/read count limits are retired completely; orchestration-level recovery safety caps (LedgerKernel bounding maximum milestone recovery retries against runaway infinite loops, DESIGN_DEFAULT: 3) remain strictly at the milestone retry boundary.
evaluated_signals: Whether repeated calls return identical outputs vs. new information
Whether new OBSERVED evidence or workspace state change occurred
Whether overall task progress is advancing
Whether the call is a reasonable retry after a failure or edit
observation_first_telemetry.intervention_rule: Apply selective, minimal intervention (e.g., surface diagnostic hint or require alternative action) only when telemetry confirms non-progressing wasteful looping.

universal_safety_guard_contract.rationale: Because Bulldozer (Hydrogen XHigh) gains general run_command access and Excavator's role wrapper is retired, protected-path and authority invariants must be enforced across ALL mutation pathways (both shell commands AND file-mutation tools) so a model cannot bypass shell protections by switching to a file tool.

ledger_and_lock.sole_authoritative_writer: LedgerKernel (src/core/ledger-kernel.mjs) and lock-manager.mjs via internal host Node.js FS APIs

v1_compatibility_migration.sole_authoritative_writer: Compatibility Adapter (src/core/v1-compat.mjs) explicit internal migration code path

authoritative_writers.model_facing_tools: Worker, coordinator, and model-facing tools (run_command, write_to_file, replace_file_content, multi_replace_file_content, write_file, edit_file) can NEVER directly mutate authoritative state/config paths.
authoritative_writers.no_bypass_markers_or_exceptions: No model-controlled bypass markers or shell exceptions may exist to evade the universal guard. Authoritative kernel/adapter components execute outside model PreToolUse mutation tools via internal host-process APIs, allowing the guard to deny protected-path mutations unconditionally.

enforced_boundaries: Protected-path mutation invariant (shell AND file-mutation tools): unconditionally deny direct writes, replacements, truncations, moves, or deletes targeting .ntg/ledger.json, .ntg/ledger.json.lock, .ntg/lightweight-runs.jsonl, hooks.json, hooks/*.py, or plugin.json from model-facing worker/coordinator tool calls, with zero model-controlled bypass markers or shell exceptions.

Role-mutation authority invariant (shell AND file-mutation tools): deny file-mutation tools and mutating shell commands when runner-injected NTG_ACTIVE_ROLE is non-mutating / READ_ONLY (zen, strix-halo, jaguar, piledriver, instinct).

Privilege-escalation & credential-bypass prevention: deny stdin/piped password injection into sudo, su, pkexec, localhost root SSH, shell-history credential mining, and wrapper/pipe/subshell equivalents.
Unauthorized persistent/destructive effect prevention: deny exploratory full-system upgrades and unauthorized destructive host/repo mutations.

Environment & marker anti-spoofing: inspect runner-injected NTG_ACTIVE_ROLE (e.g., Zen non-mutating enforcement regardless of command string) and block commands attempting to unset/override NTG_ACTIVE_ROLE, NTG_SUPERVISOR_PID, or SKIP_LIVE_TESTS.
Direct test coverage: verified directly by tests/test_shell_safety_guard.py across allow, deny, shell bypass, file-mutation-tool bypass, and marker/exception-absence cases.

retired_code_and_hooks_in_m2: scripts/runner.mjs: BULLDOZER_BUDGET_DEFAULTS, bulldozerBudgetContext, NTG_BULLDOZER_NO_SHELL, NTG_BUDGET_* caps
migrated_guard_and_telemetry_tests_in_m2: tests/test_shell_safety_guard.py (inherits privilege/destructive/protected-path/anti-spoof invariants across shell + file tools)
tests/test_telemetry_guard.py (verifies observation-first telemetry and absence of count-only blocking)

tests/test_hook_snap.mjs (or dedicated compact wiring/disposition check in m2 directly verifying hooks.json registration cleanup, universal/telemetry hook wiring, absence of retired Excavator/guard/budget files, and zero leftover retired Excavator/budget/marker plumbing in scripts/runner.mjs)
packaging_and_snap_test_alignment_in_m4: tests/test_npm_install.mjs, tests/test_install_integration.mjs updated if packaged file lists change so full discovery passes cleanly.

compatibility_contract.round_trip_requirement: Compatibility is proven only by executing load -> state/config operation -> save -> reload round-trip tests verifying semantic preservation on real 1.x fixtures for ledger.json, plan.json, and plugin.json (tests/test_v1_compat_roundtrip.mjs). Internal MinimalSpine execution compatibility is explicitly not required.

milestones.title: Phase 0: NTG 2.0 Governing Spec Alignment & Core ModelRouter
milestones.objective: Resolve old vNext spec conflicts up front by establishing the branch-local NTG 2.0 governing contract (AGENTS.md, docs/specs/ntg-2.0-architecture-contract.md, rules/orchestration.md) verified via tests/test_governing_spec.mjs (decoupling orchestration.md from test_role_guidance.mjs so un-updated agents/*.md remain clean until m2), and build the clean-room ModelRouter with PO-confirmed role slots, authority-decoupled dynamic capability overrides, session-level `agy models` catalog caching (#230), and provenance tags.
non_goals: Do not assume or hardcode unreleased model slugs such as Carbon or Helix.
Do not allow dynamic model routing overrides to expand role tool/mutation/delegation/verification permissions.
Do not rewrite agents/*.md or run agent-file prefix checks in m0 (belongs to m2).
acceptance_criteria: Branch-local AGENTS.md, canonical NTG 2.0 architecture contract, and rules/orchestration.md align cleanly with NTG 2.0 PO decisions before m1-m3 runtime code begins, verified by tests/test_governing_spec.mjs.
tests/test_role_guidance.mjs is decoupled from rules/orchestration.md so m0 does not conflict with un-updated agents/*.md.

ModelRouter resolves Steamroller (Carbon Medium -> gemini-4-argon-medium, explicitly excluding gemini-pro-orchestrator-g1-pro), Piledriver (gemini-4-argon-high), Bulldozer (gemini-4-hydrogen-xhigh), Strix Halo (gemini-4-hydrogen-high), Bobcat (gemini-4-hydrogen-medium), Jaguar & Puma (gemini-3.8-flash-low), and Zen (claude-opus-5-5-high w/ gemini-4-argon-high baseline fallback).
ModelRouter validates Steamroller dynamic model overrides fail-closed against the installed catalog while keeping role authority strictly decoupled from selected model.
listInstalledModels() is cached at runner session scope so `agy models` runs at most once per session (#230).
tests/test_governing_spec.mjs, tests/test_model_router.mjs, and tests/test_runner_spike.mjs pass under SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1.

milestones.title: Phase 1: Clean-Room LedgerKernel, Track L Log, Halo Invalidation & 1.x Round-Trip Compat
milestones.objective: Build the new thin LedgerKernel, lock manager, Track L lightweight log (.ntg/lightweight-runs.jsonl), and 1.x compatibility layer; fix #201 A1/A2/A3/A7 defects; implement Halo artifact/diff/version binding and staleness invalidation alongside full Zen GO revalidation on Tactical Replan; and verify 1.x ledger.json, plan.json, and plugin.json compatibility via load->operate->save->reload round-trip tests.
non_goals: Do not preserve 1.x MinimalSpine internal execution flow.
Do not allow Halo ACCEPT to satisfy Track S/M Zen GO requirements or allow stale Halo ACCEPT reuse.
acceptance_criteria: 1.x fixtures for ledger.json, plan.json, and plugin.json pass full load -> state/config operation -> save -> reload round-trip semantic preservation tests in tests/test_v1_compat_roundtrip.mjs; protected data/config migration runs exclusively via Compatibility Adapter's explicit internal code path (src/core/v1-compat.mjs).

#201 A1, A2, A3, A7 invariants are resolved cleanly in LedgerKernel (candidate separation on replan, owner-token verified lock recovery, code-computed delivered_tree_digest binding, explicit blocker resolution).
Tactical Replan increments plan_version and marks all existing Zen GO verdicts and prior Halo receipts STALE for full revalidation.
Halo reviews bind to candidate/run ID, reviewed_diff_digest, acceptance_criteria_digest, and plan_version; changing files, criteria, or evidence invalidates prior Halo ACCEPT.

Track L writes HALO_LIGHTWEIGHT records exclusively via LightweightLog / LedgerKernel internal APIs to .ntg/lightweight-runs.jsonl cleanly separated from Track S/M ZEN_DURABLE records owned by LedgerKernel in .ntg/ledger.json.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Model-Aware Harnesses, Role/Test Cleanup & Universal Mutation Safety Guards
milestones.objective: Implement the Model-Aware Harness (Model-Common Calibration preserving native model traits + Role-Specific Directives + ContextDigest + Lightweight Worker Harness for Jaguar/Puma 3.8 Flash Low); update agents/*.md and agent-role tests together; retire Excavator, legacy shell guards, hard-count budget-guard, retired hooks.json registrations, runner budget/marker plumbing, and obsolete legacy tests (verified directly in m2 via updated tests/test_hook_snap.mjs or a compact wiring/disposition regression test); grant Bulldozer general shell access under universal hooks/shell-safety-guard.py protecting BOTH shell AND file-mutation tools with zero model-controlled bypasses; migrate Zen guard to runner-injected NTG_ACTIVE_ROLE=zen (#201 A4); and deploy observation-first telemetry.
non_goals: Do not copy verbatim code or prompts from GJC or OmO.
Do not normalize away model-specific reasoning/delegation strengths or merge Puma into Bobcat.
